text: How do they get, if they have it indoor, if they designate an area indoor, how does that get around the 10? Aren't they stopping the sales because there's gatherings of more than 10 people?

text: And we don't know when this is going to end. I mean, this could be another year or so. And a lot of the people that I represent are just small, you know, private lenders, like the dentists and the doctors. And after six, seven, eight months of no payments, it kind of puts the dentists.

text: What's your position?

text: I, I don't know. I think we have a hearing said he was supposed to be here. So I mean, he's basically Fernandez is not his attorney. So he's basically not present at the, at the hearing.

speaker: robertpearson
text: Right.

speaker: alejandrohernandez
text: Well, that's true that I'm not the attorney judge, but under the civil code of civil procedure and the property code, he can have a non-attorney represent him and that's statutory. So in a JP court, plus I wanted to point out that in his discovery responses, he pretty much says he, he's washing cars right now for income. I don't, I know that he's not making any type of significant amount of income doing that before this whole situation happened. He actually worked for the landlord.

speaker: robertpearson
text: I'm going to reset it. I'm not going to just cut him out because he didn't appear, but he should have been here. Something that's important. We're going to reschedule it. When can we get rescheduled? You all tell me what your desire is.

text: Okay. Okay, we'll get a new log on and we'll see you on the 20th. Is there any issues in regard to the discovery?

speaker: robertpearson
text: Mr. Hernandez?

text: Yeah, well, I told him that if he was in possession of any documents like that, he stated he wasn't.

text: But he's in custody and control, so if he has access to those records.

text: It's not possession only, Mr. Hernandez. It's whether he has a right to access and he has to produce them.

text: Yeah, I don't think he, I think he has to set something up to access them. So I'm not sure, but we could get that clarified by the 29th and we could amend those responses. text: So the year is 2020 for the production of the, is it, what were you asking for in those three months?

text: 2020, I asked him for his, in interrogatories, a sworn response as to what his income was and what his expenses were. And I also asked for production of bank statements. speaker: robertpearson
text: Mr. Hernandez, you need to amend your answer to those. If they're, for the one that the year was not listed, it's 2020. The other one that it's not just simply he has possession of them, it's whether he has a right to access them. And I don't.

text: So I guess he might, if he has a bank account, he might have to go to the bank to order those statements. I'm not sure how he can get them, but, or even if he has a bank account, like I'm not sure about that, but my understanding is he didn't have one.

speaker: robertpearson
text: So- Okay, let's just need to clarify, if he doesn't have them, you can affirmatively state that he doesn't have any bank account at any financial institution. You can't deny to get those just because I don't have them in my possession. If he has a right to get them, he needs to get them and provide those.

text: Yeah, I know that some banks, you can either access it by creating an online account or order them from the bank, and then they'll mail it to you, so.

text: That's access.

text: Yeah.
